body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> C.Crane(www.ccrane.com) presented its MP3 player 'CC Witness' at the CES 2009.
The CC Witness is the only digital MP3 recorder/player that also has both AM and FM radio onboard. Radio lovers have been waiting a long time for an MP3 recorder and player that meets their needs.

The CC Witness has 2GB of onboard memory and up to 16GB of external memory on an optional SD card. That's enough memory to record your favorite radio programs, your thoughts, lectures and lots of music. You'll have plenty of room to store hundreds of hours of voice recordings, and still have room for more.

If you've ever worried about missing your favorite radio show, then the CC Witness might just make your day — it has a timer! You can preset it to record up to 20 programs in advance. You can also make MP3 recordings of AM/FM radio programs (or anything else you can connect to the line-in) on the fly.

We know that a high-quality digital recorder like this can also be used for other applications. You can use the CC Witness to record internet radio music, meetings, memos, language lessons, or even that memoir you've been wanting to write, and you can use it for file storage or as an MP3 player, to play back your favorite songs or audio books.
